wholePhysicalScope: The current mapped way encloses the named temple point and distinguishes the four corners and projecting east approach. Its present exposed base is smaller than the approximately 77 m site reported during excavation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the five terraced ranks, exposed vaults and octagonal shrine at Koe-thaung Temple. Nearer levels resolve stupa rows, masonry courses and two-tier east stairs.
limitations: This shows the exterior as a standing and restored ruin. It does not restore a continuous ancient superstructure or claim every stupa position survived.

Tier widths, vault openings, surviving stupa counts and roof heights are inferred from two current side photographs and the survey text. Individual reliefs, interior figures and contemporary railings are outside scope.
Original Terrarium sampling gives the site grade; exact thresholds and historic course elevations are approximate.
